test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In how many least number of complete years will a sum of money become more than four times of itself at the rate of 14 percent per annum on simple interest?
solution:
Given:

The principal amount becomes more than four times itself.

Rate of interest = 14% p.a. 

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

Calculation:

Let's suppose, in Q years a sum of money (let P) becomes four times itself at the rate of 20 per cent per annum on simple interest.

​According to the question,

P + (P × 14 × Q)/100 = 4P

⇒ 7PQ/50 = 3P

⇒ Q = 150/7

⇒ Q = 21 years (approx)

So, to become more than four times itself, the principal must take at least (21 + 1) i.e 22 complete years.

∴ It will take 22 years.
